narrative: Priyanka Nair, policy WTP-PLS-200501. A strike by French air traffic controllers grounded all SkyMeridian flights to Paris from 1 to 4 October, so my trip couldn't go ahead. The airline refunded my flight, but my hotel was prepaid and non-refundable: $1,240.00. That's what I'm claiming.
